value.summary: Rewrote lib/logger.mjs with leveled logging. Added an ordered level set debug < info < warn < error, a module-level active level defaulting to info, getLevel()/setLevel(level) (setLevel throws on unknown levels), per-level emit functions debug/info/warn/error that no-op below the active level and write to console.error otherwise, and kept the existing log(message) export as an info-level emit so current behavior at the default level is unchanged. Only lib/logger.mjs was modified, per the declared write target.

observations.statement: lib/logger.mjs now exports log, debug, info, warn, error, setLevel, getLevel; level ordering is debug < info < warn < error with info active by default, matching the clarification's recommended default.

evidenceCandidates.statement: lib/logger.mjs now provides emit functions at the four ordered levels (debug/info/warn/error), satisfying "Log messages can be emitted at levels" pending verification by T003/T004.
